title: Sparkly laptop
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Laptop screen -->
  <rect x="20" y="18" width="60" height="40" rx="5" ry="5" fill="#4A90D9"/>
  <!-- Screen inner display -->
  <rect x="25" y="23" width="50" height="30" rx="3" ry="3" fill="#2D6BB4"/>
  <!-- Screen glow / content on display -->
  <rect x="30" y="28" width="40" height="4" rx="2" fill="#7EC8F0"/>
  <rect x="30" y="36" width="30" height="4" rx="2" fill="#7EC8F0"/>
  <rect x="30" y="44" width="35" height="4" rx="2" fill="#5BB8E8"/>
  <!-- Laptop base / keyboard -->
  <rect x="12" y="58" width="76" height="18" rx="4" ry="4" fill="#8CB8E8"/>
  <!-- Keyboard top surface highlight -->
  <rect x="18" y="60" width="64" height="5" rx="2" fill="#B0D4F5"/>
  <!-- Keyboard keys suggestion -->
  <rect x="24" y="67" width="8" height="4" rx="1" fill="#6A9FD8"/>
  <rect x="36" y="67" width="8" height="4" rx="1" fill="#6A9FD8"/>
  <rect x="48" y="67" width="8" height="4" rx="1" fill="#6A9FD8"/>
  <rect x="60" y="67" width="8" height="4" rx="1" fill="#6A9FD8"/>
  <rect x="34" y="72" width="32" height="3" rx="1" fill="#6A9FD8"/>
  <!-- Trackpad -->
  <rect x="42" y="60" width="16" height="4" rx="2" fill="#A0C8EE"/>
  <!-- Sparkle 1 - top left, large -->
  <g transform="translate(28, 12)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-6" x2="0" y2="6" stroke="#FFE566" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-6" y1="0" x2="6" y2="0" stroke="#FFE566" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-4" y1="-4" x2="4" y2="4" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="4" y1="-4" x2="-4" y2="4" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="2" fill="#FFF8B0"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 2 - top right, medium -->
  <g transform="translate(76, 14)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-5" x2="0" y2="5" stroke="#FFB347" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-5" y1="0" x2="5" y2="0" stroke="#FFB347" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-3.5" y1="-3.5" x2="3.5" y2="3.5" stroke="#FFA000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="3.5" y1="-3.5" x2="-3.5" y2="3.5" stroke="#FFA000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="1.5" fill="#FFE0A0"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 3 - right side, small -->
  <g transform="translate(88, 42)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-4" x2="0" y2="4" stroke="#FFE566" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-4" y1="0" x2="4" y2="0" stroke="#FFE566" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="1.3" fill="#FFF8B0"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 4 - bottom left, small -->
  <g transform="translate(8, 80)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-4" x2="0" y2="4" stroke="#FFB347" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-4" y1="0" x2="4" y2="0" stroke="#FFB347" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="1.3" fill="#FFE0A0"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 5 - bottom right, medium -->
  <g transform="translate(86, 84)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-5" x2="0" y2="5" stroke="#FFE566" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-5" y1="0" x2="5" y2="0" stroke="#FFE566" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-3.5" y1="-3.5" x2="3.5" y2="3.5" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="3.5" y1="-3.5" x2="-3.5" y2="3.5" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="1.5" fill="#FFF8B0"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 6 - left side, tiny -->
  <g transform="translate(5, 38)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-3" x2="0" y2="3" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-3" y1="0" x2="3" y2="0" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="1" fill="#FFF8B0"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 7 - top center, small -->
  <g transform="translate(52, 6)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-3.5" x2="0" y2="3.5" stroke="#FFE566" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-3.5" y1="0" x2="3.5" y2="0" stroke="#FFE566" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="1.1" fill="#FFF8B0"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkle 8 - right upper, tiny -->
  <g transform="translate(90, 22)">
    <line x1="0" y1="-2.5" x2="0" y2="2.5" stroke="#FFB347" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="-2.5" y1="0" x2="2.5" y2="0" stroke="#FFB347" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="0.9" fill="#FFE0A0"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Tiny dot sparkles -->
  <circle cx="18" cy="30" r="1.5" fill="#FFE566"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="55" r="1.5" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="88" r="1.5" fill="#FFB347"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="90" r="1.2" fill="#FFE566"/>
  <circle cx="14" cy="55" r="1.2" fill="#FFD700"/>
</svg>
